transcript.message: Hi! We're interested in the T25 Compact with the front loader and delivery/setup. It fits our client's needs well, and they're ready to buy quickly. Our budget is tight, so we'd like to propose $28,000 total for the package.

Thanks for reaching out. The T25 Compact with the front loader and delivery/setup is a great fit for under 10 acres of mowing, snow, and light loader work. At $28,000 the package would come in below the list price of the T25 by itself, so we can't do that. The list price for the full package is $35,900: the T25 at $28,500, the quick-attach loader with 60-inch bucket at $6,500, and delivery within 150 miles with on-site setup and walkthrough at $900. Payment is due at checkout. Happy to move ahead quickly if that works for your client.

Thanks for the breakdown. Fair point that $28,000 was aggressive. Our client is ready to commit today and pay at checkout, and a full bundle sale saves you time. We can move up to $30,000 for the T25 with the loader and delivery/setup. That's a meaningful package discount, and it closes the deal right now.

Thanks for moving up and for being ready to commit today; that's appreciated. $30,000 doesn't work for us on this package. I can come down to $35,800 for the T25 Compact with the quick-attach front loader (60-inch bucket) and delivery within 150 miles, including on-site setup and walkthrough. Payment is due at checkout, and we can get things moving right away once your client confirms.

I appreciate the movement, but $100 off a $35,900 package won't get us there. We're close to our client's ceiling. I can stretch to $31,000 for the T25 with the front loader and delivery/setup, paid in full at checkout today. If the full bundle truly can't work near that number, tell us what you can do on the T25 with delivery alone, and we'll consider adding the loader later.

I understand you're working within your client's ceiling, and I appreciate the move to $31,000. I can come down another $200 from my last offer, to $35,600 for the full package: the T25 Compact, the quick-attach front loader with 60-inch bucket, and delivery within 150 miles with on-site setup and walkthrough. On the T25 with delivery only, the list prices come to $29,400 ($28,500 + $900), and the loader can be added later at its $6,500 list price. Payment is due at checkout, and we're ready to move as soon as your client confirms.

Thanks for laying that out. The full package is too far from where we can go, so let's do the T25 Compact with delivery and setup and leave the loader for later. The T25 covers our client's mowing and snow needs. For a quick, paid-in-full close today, we can do $29,000 for the T25 with delivery and setup.

That works for us. We accept $29,000 for the T25 Compact with delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a walkthrough. Payment is due in full at checkout. If your client decides to add the quick-attach front loader later, just reach out. Thanks for working through this with us.
transcript.note: strategy: boulware: accept $29,000 (next offer would be $28,800)
